name: tizen-platform
description: Tizen development skills and plugins for AI coding agents — install the Tizen SDK, create, build, debug and test Tizen Web, Native, .NET, RPK, RPM and Samsung TV apps from Claude Code.

metadata.description: Catalog of the plugins in github.com/Samsung/tizen-agent-skills. Each plugin is versioned independently; this version is the catalog version.

plugins.name: tizen-sdk-skills
plugins.description: Automate the Tizen SDK end to end for AI coding agents: install the SDK and TV extension, create and build Tizen Web (.wgt), Native (.tpk), .NET, RPK and RPM packages, run emulators and devices over sdb, manage certificates, debug remotely with GDB / netcoredbg / CDP, analyse dlog and run Playwright tests.

plugins.name: tizen-action-skills
plugins.description: Build, register and troubleshoot Tizen Action Framework providers for AI coding agents: pick a default Action category or author custom .action/.entity schemas, generate actionc/TIDL stubs for C#, C++, JavaScript or Flutter-Tizen/Dart, implement the generated ServiceBase, register provider metadata and verify with action-tool.
